subject: maths
name: Counting to 10
description: Counts forwards to 10 and says how many are in a small group.
mastery_criteria: Says the number names to 10 in order
Counts a group of up to 10 objects
root_reason: Counting by ones is where school maths begins.

subject: maths
name: Comparing groups to 10
description: Compares two groups of up to 10 objects and says which has more or fewer.
mastery_criteria: Says which group has more
Finds how many more in small groups

subject: maths
name: Combining and separating to 10
description: Joins and takes away small groups to 10 using objects and fingers.
mastery_criteria: Combines two small groups
Finds how many are left

subject: maths
name: Counting to 120
description: Counts forwards and backwards by ones from any starting point up to 120.
mastery_criteria: Counts on from any number to 120
Counts back from any number within 120

subject: maths
name: Skip counting by 2s, 5s and 10s
description: Counts by twos, fives and tens from zero and from other starting points.
mastery_criteria: Skip counts by 10s to 120
Skip counts by 2s and 5s

subject: maths
name: Adding and subtracting to 20
description: Adds and subtracts numbers to 20 using counting on, doubles and part-part-whole.
mastery_criteria: Adds two numbers with a total up to 20
Subtracts within 20

subject: maths
name: Measuring length with informal units
description: Measures and compares lengths by placing uniform informal units end to end.
mastery_criteria: Lines units up with no gaps or overlaps
Compares two lengths using the same unit
root_reason: Comparing lengths with everyday objects needs no earlier school maths.

subject: maths
name: Place value to 1000
description: Reads, writes and partitions three-digit numbers into hundreds, tens and ones.
mastery_criteria: Names the value of each digit
Finds 10 more or 10 less

subject: maths
name: Adding two-digit numbers
description: Adds two-digit numbers by partitioning and recombining tens and ones.
mastery_criteria: Adds two-digit numbers without regrouping
Adds two-digit numbers with regrouping

subject: maths
name: Multiplication facts for 2, 5 and 10
description: Recalls multiplication facts for twos, fives and tens and uses them in simple problems.
mastery_criteria: Recalls the 2, 5 and 10 facts
Uses a fact to solve a sharing or grouping problem

subject: maths
name: Halves, quarters and eighths
description: Names and compares halves, quarters and eighths of shapes and collections.
mastery_criteria: Names a half, a quarter and an eighth
Finds a quarter of a small collection
root_reason: Sharing into equal parts is taught here with concrete materials, so no earlier skill in this map is required.

subject: maths
name: Equivalent fractions
description: Finds fractions that name the same amount, such as 1/2 and 2/4.
mastery_criteria: Finds an equal fraction with a given denominator
Explains why two fractions are equal

subject: maths
name: Multiplying by one-digit numbers
description: Multiplies two- and three-digit numbers by one-digit numbers using written strategies.
mastery_criteria: Multiplies a two-digit number by a one-digit number
Solves word problems with multiplication

subject: maths
focusArea: Representing quantities using fractions, decimals and percentages
name: Percentages of quantities
description: Finds common percentages of amounts, including discounts in dollars.
mastery_criteria: Finds 10%, 25% and 50% of an amount
Works out a discount and sale price

subject: maths
name: Area of rectangles
description: Calculates the area of rectangles in square centimetres and square metres.
mastery_criteria: Multiplies length by width
Finds a missing side from the area

subject: maths
name: Angles on a straight line
description: Uses the fact that angles on a straight line add to 180 degrees to find unknown angles.
mastery_criteria: States that a straight angle is 180 degrees
Finds an unknown angle on a straight line
root_reason: Measuring angles in degrees is introduced in this topic for the fixture, so it has no prerequisite here.

subject: english
name: Hearing rhyming words
description: Hears and picks words that rhyme in spoken language.
mastery_criteria: Picks a word that rhymes
Says when two words do not rhyme
root_reason: Listening for rhyme uses the spoken language children bring to school.

subject: english
name: Letter–sound links
description: Matches single letters to the sounds they most often make.
mastery_criteria: Names the first sound of a word
Matches the sound to its letter

subject: english
name: Blending CVC words
description: Blends three sounds to read short consonant-vowel-consonant words.
mastery_criteria: Blends c-a-t to say cat
Reads short CVC words

subject: english
name: Digraphs sh, ch and th
description: Reads and writes words with the digraphs sh, ch and th.
mastery_criteria: Reads words starting or ending with sh, ch, th
Spells simple words with these digraphs

subject: english
name: Capital letters and full stops
description: Starts sentences and names with capital letters and ends statements with full stops.
mastery_criteria: Uses a capital letter to start a sentence
Ends a statement with a full stop
root_reason: Writing a simple sentence is the starting point for punctuation in this map.

subject: english
name: Spelling high-frequency words
description: Spells common words such as said, because and friend correctly.
mastery_criteria: Picks the correct spelling of common words
Chooses to, too or two correctly

subject: english
name: Adding -ed for the past
description: Adds -ed to verbs, doubling the last letter or changing y to i when needed.
mastery_criteria: Adds -ed to regular verbs
Doubles the consonant in short words like hop

subject: english
name: Finding the main idea
description: Identifies what a short paragraph is mostly about.
mastery_criteria: Picks the main idea of a paragraph
Chooses a suitable title
root_reason: Finding the main idea is taught as a starting point for comprehension in this map.

subject: english
name: Making inferences
description: Uses clues in a text to work out what is not stated directly.
mastery_criteria: Infers a feeling from actions
Infers what happened from clues

subject: english
name: Commas in complex sentences
description: Uses a comma after an opening dependent clause.
mastery_criteria: Places the comma after an opening clause
Spots a sentence that needs a comma

subject: english
name: Prefixes and suffixes
description: Uses common prefixes and suffixes to change and work out word meanings.
mastery_criteria: Explains un-, re- and mis-
Uses -ful and -less
